# Análisis de diseño experimental

## Base de datos

>https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1RzSRtKS2CV_Zf0rA3Ynb83axrVmXeRN4NjMhHWmHECM/edit?gid=0#gid=0

## Indentificar los factores 

1. Factor 1: boro
1. Factor 2: potasio

## Identificar el modelo

Factorial en DBCA

$$Y = \mu + bloque + B + P + B*P + \xi$$

# Project steup

```{r}
#| label: setup

source('https://inkaverse.com/setup.r')
```

# Activar los paquetes

```{r}
gs <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1RzSRtKS2CV_Zf0rA3Ynb83axrVmXeRN4NjMhHWmHECM/edit?gid=0#gid=0" %>%
  as_sheets_id()

fb <- gs %>%
  range_read(ss = ., sheet = "fb",
             col_types = "ccccddddd") %>%
  mutate(across(c(1:4), ~ as.factor(.)))

fb %>% str()
summary(fb$peso_fruto)
```

# Análisis de variancia

```{r}
# aov() ó lm()

fb_factorial <- fb %>%
  filter(tratamiento != "T0") %>%
  droplevels()

md <- aov(ancho_fruto ~ bloque + boro + potasio +
            boro * potasio, fb_factorial)

anova(md)
```

# Comparación de medias

```{r}
mc <- emmeans(md, ~ boro * potasio)

# Letras de significancia
tab <- cld(mc,
           adjust = "tukey",
           Letters = letters,
           decreasing = TRUE)

tab
```

# Representación gráfica

```{r}
pl <- plot_smr(data = tab
               , x = "boro"
               , y = "emmean"
               , group = "potasio"
               , error = "SE"
               , sig = ".group"
               , ylab = "Ancho del fruto (cm)"
               )

pl
```
